title: VerifAI: A Verifiable Open-Source Search Engine for Biomedical Question Answering
authors: Miloš Košprdić; Adela Ljajić; Bojana Bašaragin; Darija Medvecki; Lorenzo Cassano; Nikola Milošević
why_relevant: VerifAI integrates post-hoc NLI-based claim verification into a biomedical RAG pipeline to detect hallucinations and reduce unsupported citations, relevant to verification/control mechanisms for unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific application rather than general robustness study; verification is a known technique applied to biomedical QA.
